turns.student: AoA. mujhe AI engineer banna hai aur Canada jana hai. kaise jaun?
turns.reply: AoA — tum AI engineer ban'na chahte ho aur Canada jaana chahte ho; is goal par baad mein wapas aayenge. Ab batao, abhi tum kya kar rahe ho—padhai, naukri, ya kuch aur?

turns.student: ICS kiya hai is saal, result aa gaya. Ab free hoon
turns.reply: Tumne ICS complete kiya aur ab free ho.

action.question: Kya tumne programming ki hai; agar haan to konsi language use ki?

turns.student: 68% aaye. Theek hai bas, maths mein kam aaye
turns.reply: Tumne ICS 68% ke saath pass kiya aur maths mein kam score aaya.

action.question: Kya tumne school/college ke dauran koi programming ya AI-related projects ya courses kiye hain?

turns.student: dono thora. Calculus bilkul samajh nahi aata tha. Computer mein acha tha
turns.reply: Calculus bilkul samajh nahi aaya aur computer mein acha tha.

action.question: Computer mein 'acha' se kya matlab—konsa kaam ya project tumne khud kiya?

turns.student: programming. C++ mein patterns wagaira banana. Python bhi seekha hai maine khud
turns.reply: Tum C++ mein patterns banate thay aur khud se Python seekhi hai.

action.question: Kya tumne koi chalne wala project ya program banaya hai—ek misaal batao?

turns.student: YouTube pe ek 12 ghante ka course hai, us se
turns.reply: I want to understand you properly. Could you tell me a little more?

turns.student: ... aadha shayad. 5-6 ghante
turns.reply: Tumne woh course 5–6 ghante dekh liye; aadha raha. Kya tumne koi chhota programming project banaya jo dekhane layak ho?

turns.student: exams aa gaye the. Phir dobara start nahi kiya
turns.reply: Exams ki wajah se course dobara shuru nahi kiya.

action.question: Kya tumhare paas koi code file ya GitHub repository hai jisme tumne C++ ya Python projects rakhe hon?

turns.student: AoA. mujhe AI engineer banna hai aur Canada jana hai. kaise jaun?
turns.reply: Samjha — aap AI engineer banna chahtay hain aur Canada jana chahtay hain; is par baad mein wapas aata hoon. Abhi aap kya kar rahay hain?

turns.student: ICS kiya hai is saal, result aa gaya. Ab free hoon
turns.reply: Samjha — aapne ICS complete kar liya aur ab free hain. Aapke final marks (percent ya grades) kya rahe?

turns.student: 68% aaye. Theek hai bas, maths mein kam aaye
turns.reply: Samjha — aapko 68% miley aur maths kam raha.

turns.student: dono thora. Calculus bilkul samajh nahi aata tha. Computer mein acha tha
turns.reply: Samjha — calculus bilkul samajh nahi aata tha magar computer mein aap acha thay. Computer mein aap ne specifically kya kiya?

turns.student: programming. C++ mein patterns wagaira banana. Python bhi seekha hai maine khud
turns.reply: Samjha — aap C++ mein patterns banate thay aur self-taught Python seekhi. Kya aapne koi project banaya hai jo dikha sakte ho?

turns.student: YouTube pe ek 12 ghante ka course hai, us se
turns.reply: Samjha — aapne YouTube ka 12 ghante ka course kiya. Kya us course se koi project complete kiya hai jo aap dikha sakte ho?

turns.student: ... aadha shayad. 5-6 ghante
turns.reply: Samjha — aapne course ka lagbhag aadha hissa (5-6 ghante) kiya aur project aadha complete hai. Kya aapne project ka code kahin save kiya hai jise main dekh sakun?

turns.student: exams aa gaye the. Phir dobara start nahi kiya
turns.reply: Samjha — aapne project aadha chhor diya kyunki exams aa gaye thay. Aaj rozana kitna waqt AI ya programming seekhne ko de sakte ho?

turns.student: AoA. mujhe AI engineer banna hai aur Canada jana hai. kaise jaun?
turns.reply: Wa alaikum assalam, Danish. AI engineer banne aur Canada jane par wapas aayenge; raaste ki maloomat official sources se check hogi. Pehle tumhein samajhna zaroori hai: aaj kal tumhara aam din kaise guzarta hai?

action.question: Canada jane aur AI engineering mein career banane ke raaston ki official sources se tasdeeq karein; student ki taleem aur halaat abhi maloom nahin, is liye filhaal zaati eligibility ka faisla na karein.

turns.student: ICS kiya hai is saal, result aa gaya. Ab free hoon
turns.reply: Is saal ICS kiya hai, aur ab free ho. In dinon apna waqt kis kaam mein guzarte ho?

turns.student: 68% aaye. Theek hai bas, maths mein kam aaye
turns.reply: 68% aaye, aur maths mein kam rahe. Maths ki tayari karte waqt sab se zyada mushkil kis cheez mein hoti thi?

turns.student: dono thora. Calculus bilkul samajh nahi aata tha. Computer mein acha tha
turns.reply: Calculus samajh nahi aata tha, lekin computer mein acha tha. Computer mein apne kiye hue kisi ek kaam ke baare mein bataoge?

turns.student: programming. C++ mein patterns wagaira banana. Python bhi seekha hai maine khud
turns.reply: C++ mein patterns banaye aur Python khud seekha. Python mein apne banaye hue kisi ek program ke baare mein bataoge?

turns.student: YouTube pe ek 12 ghante ka course hai, us se
turns.reply: Python YouTube ke 12 ghante wale course se seekha. Us mein se ab tak kya khud code karke chalaya hai?

turns.student: ... aadha shayad. 5-6 ghante
turns.reply: Ab tak course ke takreeban 5–6 ghante dekhe hain. Dekhte hue khud kya code likh kar chalaya tha?

turns.student: exams aa gaye the. Phir dobara start nahi kiya
turns.reply: Exams ki wajah se course ruk gaya, phir dobara shuru nahi hua. Exams ke baad kis cheez mein tumhara waqt guzarta raha?
